trigger: a second open() on a live ScopedKey; none at HEAD (all four sites open a fresh object once)
classification_rationale: the base owner (RegKey::put) reset first; the seam's owner overwrote a held key without closing it
summary: ScopedKey::open overwrote a held key without closing it, and the Resource Ledger called the class move-only though it is neither copyable nor movable. Reported independently by cpp-expert, cpp-safety, security-guardian and sre (4). fixed in 25123ee64: open() closes and nulls a held key first, `watch` documents never-null, a double-open case asserts opens == closes (mutants no-close and no-reset killed); the ledger wording is corrected in the committed Resource Ledger.

trigger: a future Windows TU including <windows.h> without NOMINMAX before the shared header
classification_rationale: the base OutputBudget used (std::min); the move into the shared header dropped the repo's macro guard (ledger row cpp1-nominmax-std-min-in-os-free-header)
summary: Shared budget header used bare std::min and numeric_limits::max. Reported independently by build-ci, architect, consistency-auditor and unhappy-path (4); latent only (every current windows.h includer defines NOMINMAX first; the MSVC rig compile at 1099b6ce1 passed). fixed in 25123ee64: three sites parenthesised.

trigger: an operator reads the README caveat, the capability-matrix summary row or the plugin definition text
classification_rationale: the code skips the re-walk when the deadline has passed (win_walk.hpp:317); these summaries omitted the clause and caveat 4 still described the pre-re-walk guarantee
summary: Operator-visible summaries still stated the pre-re-walk behaviour or dropped the deadline clause (README caveat 4 and its generated twin, docs/os-capability-matrix.md:138, content/definitions/privacy_permissions.yaml:49). Reported independently by docs-writer, plugin-developer and consistency-auditor (3). fixed in 25123ee64: one-clause edits, generated JSON regenerated for this plugin only (README:52 deliberately untouched, reworded after the final rig pass).

trigger: an operator or automation reads a Windows result from a host with a stale .bak ProfileList key or many profiles
classification_rationale: the README names the new tokens but gave no action or permanence; the subject-forced changed_during_read residual was not stated
summary: README gave no operator guidance for profile_list_backup (permanent until the key is removed), the run-stop suffix (match the prefix; Windows appends :profiles_skipped_<n>, macOS stays bare) or the fixed profile order, and did not say a profile's owner can force changed_during_read on their own profile (pre-existing, unhappy-path UP-7). Reported by enterprise-readiness and unhappy-path (2). fixed in 25123ee64.

trigger: a reader (the follow-up that lifts the guard, the five other with_user_hive consumers) trusts a comment
classification_rationale: comments stated more than the code does: live_open_rc 'status ok == success', 'every method returns its code', 'the NEXT charge is refused', 'every fact from an opened HANDLE', 'shared by every leg', NUL-only skip comments, peek vocabulary, token banners without the suffix, a changelog refactor tail
summary: Eight comment/banner statements contradicted or over-stated the code (docs-writer DW-1,2,4,5,6; cpp-expert F2; architect N4; consistency-auditor F4; cross-platform CP-1; five reporters in total; CP-1's line is pre-existing). fixed in 25123ee64: all eight sub-items corrected; peek_denied renamed live_denied.

trigger: a future edit reports a refused registry read as absent, drops a failed key-open row or ignores the per-source cap; nothing fails
classification_rationale: the seam headers claim the fakes lock each branch; mutants of the refusal/failure branches and the guard's leaf-fact wiring survived the suites (109 mutants run)
summary: The walk's refusal and failure branches (denied -> absent, refused second read, capability/app-open failure rows, NonPackaged merge, per-source cap, non-NotFound store open) and the guard's leaf-fact wiring (size, owner, final path, disk file) had no lock on any host. quality-engineer QE-1 and consistency-auditor F2 (mutants m1-m7). fixed in 25123ee64: fake knobs and cases from the quality-engineer patch plus four guard sections; each lock demonstrated to fail on its mutant. Issue #5293's last bullet makes these locks part of this PR.

trigger: a future edit lets begin_profile reset the sticky deadline, re-walks on any refusal token, arms the watch after the reads or polls before them
classification_rationale: the fake watch could express only WAIT_OBJECT_0/TIMEOUT and the fake registry did not record call order; the stability protocol was observable by no test
summary: The re-walk/watch protocol was half locked (quality-engineer QE-2, unhappy-path UP-2 with three surviving mutants, cpp-safety F3 exception-path release). fixed in 25123ee64: call-order events case, WAIT_FAILED one-watch case, begin_profile-on-expired case, a bad_alloc mid-walk case (opens == closes, live watches <= 1 then 0); mutants killed.

trigger: a future edit counts a budget-dropped .bak/invalid-SID entry as emitted or makes the timeout row exclusive of the budget row
classification_rationale: skipped is correct on every exit today (driver), but two of six exits and the budget-plus-timeout case had no lock
summary: Two of the six profiles_skipped_<n> loop exits (.bak and invalid-SID commit failures) and the compound budget+timeout read were unlocked (unhappy-path UP-1, quality-engineer QE-4). fixed in 25123ee64: sections added; mutants killed.

trigger: deleting the producer line in with_user_hive or the hand-off in the collector
classification_rationale: the assertion equals the member default so it passes with the producer deleted; the discriminating check sat behind a privilege SKIP
summary: live_open_rc was locked only at its consumer (QE-3). fixed in 25123ee64 (Windows-only hunks, proven by the final rig pass): the report member is seeded with a sentinel before the call and the discriminating check moved above the privilege SKIP.

trigger: a future edit to the rows saturation or after_load stat failure
classification_rationale: rows min guard and rows saturation survived the helper's own TU; after_load stat failure had no case
summary: Residual surviving mutants (QE-5). fixed in 25123ee64: the rows half and the after_load stat failure are locked.

trigger: a future edit to the fake probe's argument handling or the second-read size bound
classification_rationale: the fake probe discards its dir/leaf/path arguments (the Windows-only rig tests are that lock); the second-read size bound needs a new fake knob for a (std::min) that cannot regress silently
summary: Two QE-5 residuals declined by the Architect: pre-existing, INFO, no tracker needed (the rig TU covers the fake-probe argument handling).

trigger: a deadline callback that does not go through RetentionBudget::expired (the follow-up lift) while the deadline passes during the offline-lock wait before the LAST profile
classification_rationale: the run-level timeout row depended on the injected callback marking the budget; the structural coupling of the base guard was lost with the injection
summary: The run-level collection:timeout row relied on a side effect of the injected deadline callback (architect N1; verified with a scratch driver). fixed in 25123ee64: the pure assembler marks the budget itself when the guard refuses with timeout (distinct from the code-review L10 ruling, which rejected an assertion on the production lambda); two sections lock it and fail on the unfixed header.

trigger: a transient *.TM.blf/*.regtrans-ms sidecar deleted between the (now whole) listing and its attribute open
classification_rationale: the listing is now taken whole before the first probe (the old loop probed each name as listed), widening the window; the open-failure-refuses rule is old
summary: A sidecar that vanished after being listed refused the profile with hive_stat_failed:win32_2 (UP-3). fixed in 25123ee64: ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND on a just-listed name is treated as absent; every other code including PATH_NOT_FOUND still refuses; two guard sections, mutants killed.

trigger: a follow-up consumer omits the deadline callback
classification_rationale: an empty std::function would throw bad_function_call inside before_load under the offline lock; the one caller supplies it
summary: Proposed `if (expired && expired())` was REJECTED by the Architect: an omitted callback fails loud and closed (RAII unwinds, plugin reports internal_error), whereas the guard would silently drop the deadline, a bounded wait the never-cut list protects; the right shape (a required constructor argument) is decided at lift time in #5291.

trigger: Tally::row with an empty string after the byte budget was exactly filled; no production caller can do this
classification_rationale: RowByteBudget::fits(0) at an overspent budget admits where the old inline test refused; every t.row() argument is a formatted non-empty row
summary: The lone divergence found by five independent differentials (205M, 36M, 6.1M, 1.1M and 200k cases) between the old arithmetic and the shared helper. Reported by happy-path, cpp-expert, architect, plugin-developer and compliance-officer (5). fixed in 25123ee64: comments state that rows are never empty; no arithmetic change and no pinning test (it would lock behaviour no caller can reach).

trigger: a ProfileList key such as junk.bak
classification_rationale: the predicate accepts any key ending .bak while the docs said <SID>.bak; both are unreadable and never read
summary: is_profile_backup_entry is suffix-only (F5). fixed in 25123ee64: the predicate comment and README now say a key ending .bak (Windows writes only <SID>.bak); no stem validator (the shared model has no SID validator).

trigger: building the agent tests with a 32-bit size_t (an armv7 cross config; no CI leg builds it)
classification_rationale: std::size_t{1} << 40 is undefined where size_t is 32 bits
summary: The portable budget test shifted past 32 bits (CP-2). fixed in 25123ee64: numeric_limits<size_t>::max()/2 and /4.

trigger: a local user's process rewriting values under its own HKCU ConsentStore during a dispatch
classification_rationale: the README residual named only a busy profile; the re-walk doubles agent work per profile but both walks stay deadline-bounded
summary: A profile's owner can suppress their own Forensics read by forcing changed_during_read (UP-7). Folded into the README caveat sentence in 25123ee64 (CL-4).

trigger: n/a: observations of behaviour this diff did not change
classification_rationale: three conventions for GetLastError()==0 (all fail closed, UP-4); per-source caps ignore the <profile>\ qualifier (UP-17); a budget-dropped profile's tokens still reach the accumulator (UP-18); deadline overrun after expiry quantified (UP-16)
summary: Pre-existing, documented or fail-closed observations from the unhappy-path register that this change does not alter; no action. UP-19 (the rig host has no .bak entry and no skipped profile, so those rows have fake coverage only) is disclosed in the PR body instead.

trigger: a future caller passing k.get() as the parent of k.open(); none exists (the four production sites each open a fresh object once)
classification_rationale: the close-before-reopen added for CL-1 means a self-parented re-open would hand open_key a just-closed handle; the precondition was undocumented
summary: Gate 8 re-review of the governance fix round: ScopedKey::open closes the held key before open_key(parent, ...), so k.open(k.get(), n) passes a just-closed parent. No caller does this. Fixed in af75ba8f4: comment-only precondition note (parent must not be this key's own get()).
